_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05 (batch S10). The 'Switch&Jog' jogging configuration of the modular Veer Switchback system. Shares its car-seat adapter with veer-switchback-roll (adapter-veer-switchback). Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Veer Switch&Jog (Switchback System jogging stroller)

clekListed.clekRow: Veer — Switchback & Jog — Switchback Infant Car Seat Adapter – Cybex/Maxi-Cosi/Nuna

specs._weightNote: Frame only 21.2 lb; frame + Switchback Seat 28.7 lb (seat 7.5 lb). Seat sold separately in some bundles.
specs._dimsNote: Open 44 x 27 x 39 in (handle low, front wheel locked). Folded with seat 19 x 27 x 35 in; folded without seat 19 x 27 x 33 in.

brake.type: foot parking brake plus hand-operated deceleration/drag brake for downhill jogging

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: 0+ years with Infant Insert (or infant car seat + adapter); jog when child can sit unassisted per Veer

specs._capacityNote: Max child 50 lb; seating area 19 H x 12 W x 9.5 D in. Max child height not published by Veer.

safety.standards: Meets or exceeds ASTM (16 CFR 1227 / ASTM F833) and EN 1888.2 safety standards
safety.notes: 5-point safety harness; fixed/lockable front wheel for jogging; deceleration hand brake; wrist strap.

specs.foldType: one-hand open and fold (seat can stay on or come off)
specs.tires: XL air-filled pneumatic tires: 12 in front / 16 in rear; fixed front wheel for jogging

notes: Jogging configuration of the modular Veer Switchback system; the '&Jog' frame takes large 16 in pneumatic rear tires + fixed front wheel. Uses the Switchback Infant Car Seat Adapter (adapter-veer-switchback), the SAME adapter as veer-switchback-roll; that adapter (Cybex/Maxi-Cosi/Nuna) explicitly lists the Clek Liing. $899 DTC (in stock) and $899 at REI (pre-order/backorder). Weight 28.7 lb with seat / 21.2 lb frame.
